Front Page · Tonight in the Vault

Work Hours Tonight: Bring What You're Building

One hour, your project, and the whole Vault working alongside you — tonight at 6 PM ET.

ELKHART — The Vault opens its doors tonight for Skool Work Hours, running Tuesday, November 17 from 6:00 to 7:00 PM ET. Bring whatever you are building — a product, a page, a post, a plan — and work on it live with Glam and your fellow members.

Work Hours are the Vault's working session: cameras on, projects open, progress made in real time. Stuck on a step? Ask it live. Starting something new? Start it tonight, with the room beside you. One focused hour is all it takes to leave with something finished that wasn't finished this morning.

The Zoom link lives inside the Vault, so members can head straight there when the hour begins. Bring a project, bring your questions — and leave with progress.

When: Tonight, 6:00–7:00 PM ET Where: Zoom link inside the Vault Bring: The project you're building
